text.text:
*How it works*
1.  Run `/pac` in any channel
2.  Select your scenario and answer 5 risk questions
3.  Get your risk level (Low / Elevated / High) with recommended next steps
4.  Notify HR directly from Slack if needed
5.  HR reviews, responds, and updates the case — all in Slack
6.  Full case history, audit log, and documents available in the web app
